meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 为 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘并推送数据快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 NanoClaw 并需要可视化运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard and push data snapshots to NanoClaw
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and need to visualize its runtime status

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 装上本地监控面板:定期推送数据库快照和日志到面板,浏览器可查看会话、用户、Token 用量、上下文窗口、消息与实时日志。
howto.when: 当用户要求给 NanoClaw 添加监控面板或仪表盘时触发。技能会自动安装包、复制推送模块、改 src/index.ts、配环境变量,然后构建、测试并重启服务。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加一个监控面板。
say.note: 会执行安装和接线,重启后即可打开仪表盘。

say.text: 帮我设置 DASHBOARD_SECRET 和监控端口。

howto.what_en: Installs a local monitoring dashboard for NanoClaw. A pusher sends DB snapshots every 60s and log lines every 2s to the dashboard, which shows agent groups, sessions, channels, users, token usage, context windows, message activity, and real-time logs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. It installs the dashboard package, copies pusher and tests, edits src/index.ts, adds env vars, builds, tests, restarts, and verifies.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Installs and wires it up; dashboard is available after restart.
It performs the code edits and configuration automatically.

say_en.text: Set up DASHBOARD_SECRET and the dashboard port.
say_en.note: Generates a random secret and writes the .env entries.
